title.narrative: Understanding Chinese Legal Economic Reform 2020 (EUCLERA)

description.narrative: Contract related to: Understanding Chinese Legal Economic Reform 2020 (EUCLERA) - The proposed support for EU policies in China will fund five actions with immediate needs for financial resources, aiming to inform, enhance, maintain and contribute to EU relations and interests towards China:  1) EU trade and investments, with the continuation of the project ¿Understanding Chinese Legal Reform 2020 (EUCLERA)¿ ¿ PI/2019/407-3362) Consumer protection, with the continuation of the project ¿EU-China (Asia) action on consumer protection and non-food product safety in Asia¿ ¿ PI/2019/409-9973) Migration and Mobility dialogue, with the continuation of the project ¿EU-China Dialogue on Migration and Mobility support (MMSP II)¿ - PI/2019/407-0684) Labour and Social rights, with the continuation of the project ¿Improving China¿s institutional capacity towards universal social protection¿ - PI/2019/406-2715) Economic Empowerment of Women
